m40_schedule_bridge.payload_layout: I_KY_KX_O, C-order little-endian signed int8; O is contiguous and divisible into eight 96-lane vectors

quantization_contract.accumulator_init: signed int32 zero for every output channel because all four Conv2d modules are bias-free
quantization_contract.division_and_rounding_reference: divide original float32 promoted to float64 by stored float32 scale promoted to float64; numpy.rint/IEEE round-to-nearest-ties-to-even
quantization_contract.runtime_integer_product: signed support/delta polarity times signed int8 weight
quantization_contract.saturation: clip the rounded integer to inclusive [-127,127]; record pre-clip violations and require zero for this checkpoint
quantization_contract.scale_definition: float32(max(abs(weight[channel])) / 127); an all-zero channel uses exact float32 1.0
quantization_contract.scale_fixed_point_candidate: unsigned UQ0.31 little-endian uint32, round-to-nearest-ties-to-even and saturate to [0,2^32-1]
quantization_contract.weight_payload_layout: I_KY_KX_O, C-order little-endian signed int8; O is contiguous and divisible into eight 96-lane vectors
quantization_contract.zero_handling: exact zero maps to integer zero; nonzero values may quantize to zero and are counted per channel

value_mask_multicast_scope.command_definition: one nonzero signed INT8 value plus one exact destination bit mask for each distinct nonzero value in a block
value_mask_multicast_scope.not_admitted: accumulator-cycle reduction, bank-feasible issue rate, SRAM compression, system speedup, or M42 architecture admission
value_mask_multicast_scope.scope: weight broadcast and fetch potential only
value_mask_multicast_scope.source_term_vector: for every (input_channel,kernel_y,kernel_x), the 768 signed INT8 weights over output_channel
value_mask_multicast_scope.zero_weight_rule: zero destinations emit no product command and remain zero in every value mask
